Episode 247. The Liberation War of Laprarosa (14)
In the midst of the vast electric sea, the final weapon of the Red Plutonian, sitting like an old beast in the middle of the horizon, was melting in the boiling electric fog.
The sword dance continued.
The electric sea created waves along the blade, spreading a streamlined electric fog above the surface like a whale leaping.
Inescapable waves constantly pressed against the hull. Each time the mixed energy covering the hull was washed away, a soft friction sound was made.
'More like purification than destruction...'
Murakan thought, calming his overflowing heart.
A thousand years ago, she was an ally, now hiding behind the darkness, trying to manipulate the world, Rokia. Her magic was crumbling endlessly before Jin’s  sword.
Just as Jin had said.
Times have changed. Finally, Runkandel became stronger than a thousand years ago, an unshakable family even in the face of invisible darkness and threats.
A group of such people had come together. All of this was the work of Jin, their young and precarious contractor.
"Murakan, are you crying?"
[Linpa, what nonsense, it's irritating. You speak so slowly.]
Of course, the fight was not over yet.
But the outcome was already determined. The current Jin was not someone who could be brought down by schemes or traps.
Even if Rokia had prepared some other trick, it would be futile.
[You've gone quiet, Rokia Ganesto. You must feel it too. The sword my Battle God tearing your curse apart...]
Tszzzzzzzt...! Boom-!
Kri's left armor broke under the impact. The armor that fell into the electric sea disappeared without a trace in an instant.
The giant window that had been showing Rokia's image was long destroyed. Soon, Rokia sent her spirit body outside the hull, positioning it above the central part of Kri.
The spirit body seemed ready to flee at any moment. The electric currents only struck the sky intermittently and slowly, not even aiming at the spirit body.
But escape was impossible. The only reason Lokiya's spirit could still maintain its form and position beside the Plutonian Domination Sword was that Jin allowed it.
"Yes, truly amazing. What made you so strong, Jin?"
Rokia spoke, removing her hood.
She had a face different from what Jin had seen in the image and what Murakan remembered from a thousand years ago. A strangely familiar face.
[You wouldn't understand even if you heard it.]
"That might be true."
The sword dance stopped.
Then, as Jin gestured downwards, Rokia fell onto the surface of the electric sea. The electric fog did not swallow Rokia.
[Speak.]
"What? Oh, are you asking why I betrayed Runkandel? You must have seen that in Keitam's painting..."
[No, that's not it. Are you satisfied with becoming such a monster, abandoning your family?]
Rokia's pupils widened.
"An unsettling question."
[Parasitizing other bodies, being unable to proudly face anything, feeling neither death nor fear, tainted with sin. What does such a vile life bring you?]
Your ideals will be blocked by me and others like me, and your dreams will be trampled in the same way.
Rokia was silent for a while after Jin's declaration. It was a story no one had ever asked her, one she herself had long forgotten.
"Nothing yet."
[So it is. A fitting end awaits you.]
As soon as he finished speaking, the electric sea began to swallow Rokia's spirit body.
The last spirit body on the battlefield, encompassing all others, scattered into blue particles without ever striking back.
In this battle, Rokia lost more than just a part of her spirit body. She had suffered significant damage to her real body due to Jin's unexpected power.
Kri, too, would eventually sink into the electric sea with time, never to rise again.
What remained was the curse Rokia left in Laprarosa, the Witch's Pool.
[Murakan.]
[Yeah, kid.]
[Let's go to Laprarosa now.]
[Laprarosa? Won't the liberation device activate inside in a few hours? Is it because of the curse left by Rokia?]
"Brother Jin! Brother Battle God is injured!"
It was not yet time to share the joy of victory. This fight was a war for the liberation of Laprarosa, and it would only be a perfect victory if all the Plutonian  escaped safely.
[If it were just the curse, there wouldn't have been a problem, Brother Teto. But there's been an ongoing dimensional error, and Brother Ban had to protect the others.]
Even so, Jin had not been able to venture directly into the pathway of Laprarosa.
There was the restraint of the Red Plutonian, and the uncertainty of what might happen in the storm of dimensional errors.
But now Jin felt it.
The two Plutonian Domination Swords wielded by Jin and Ban were forging a path through the dimensions, connecting like rivers.

However, the storm of dimensional errors was not completely over, and the aftermath of the Plutonian Domination Swords continued. In Jin's view, only he and Murakan could withstand it and not lose their way.
[But don't worry, brothers. I will bring back everyone without fail.]
Jin looked around.

Runtia and Veil, with their protective barriers, intermittently waited for the effects of the Plutonian Domination Swords escaping the pathway, while the Battle Kings looked at Jin with faces filled with faith instead of worry.
'Sister Luna will soon encounter Shimat.'
Luna was entering Kri, passing through the debris of the destroyed air fortresses. Inside there, it was planned to be the final battlefield for Luna and Shimat.
[Brothers, just stay here and wait while supporting Sister Luna.]
"Understood, Brother Jin."
"Even if it looks like we're losing, we won't interfere?"
[Of course. I don't think we'll lose, though.]
Jin and his brothers exchanged grinning smiles.
[Then, I'll be back.]
Without hesitation, Jin dove towards the portal to Laprarosa.
The mixed energy lingering near the portal scattered like bugs fleeing from light.
To Jin's eyes, the deep abyss-like hole was vividly portraying Laprarosa shining on the other side.
[Let's go in, Murakan.]
[Alright.]
Shortly after, the two vanished into the portal to Laprarosa.
'Jin has gone somewhere. Probably to Laprarosa.'
Inside the hull of Kri.
Luna felt the Plutonian Domination Sword's energy suddenly fluctuate and was certain. Jin had moved to save the brothers of Laprarosa.
It was intuition. And that fact did not feel alarming at all. The power of the Plutonian Domination Sword was fluctuating, not unstable.
'The power of the Plutonian Domination Sword is moving to protect Jin. In this state, I can't rely on its help while fighting Shimat.'
Luna actually liked that fact.
Even if she tried not to be conscious of it, while fighting, the desire to receive Jin's help might emerge from the depths of her heart.
Defeating Shimat with Jin's support would mean nothing. Luna wanted to defeat Shimat with her own sword.
"Your brother has entered the portal to Laprarosa, Luna Runkandel."

Startled by the sudden voice, Luna quickly turned her head. The brilliance of the Plutonian Domination Sword cast deep shadows inside the hull, and from that darkness, Shimat was striding towards her.
With each step he took, deep and immense purple energy covered an area of the Plutonian Domination Sword. It felt almost unbelievable that she hadn't noticed such energy until now.
Seeing him, Luna immediately recognized the accuracy of Jin's assessment.
'He's much stronger than before. Stronger than the day we went to get the part with the master.'
Luna lightly swung Krantel, targeting Shimat.
"So you've noticed as well."
"There's no way I wouldn't notice something even you, who hasn't surpassed the wall, can see. So, you came to repay your debt to me?"
"That's one way to put it. I wanted to defeat you with my own hands... You look good, Shimat. Using air fortresses like that didn't seem very warrior-like back then."
Shimat chuckled as he looked at Luna.
He really confirmed that she had come to fight him alone. The Plutonian Domination Sword would not protect her during the fight.
That's why Jin seemed even more remarkable to Shimat.

"There are times in this world when one must fight alone and overcome, and times when one must fight together and win. Your master, Blue Wind Emperor, used to say that often. And your brother knows that just as well."
In Shimat's grip, a new purple sword formed, and at that moment, a red light entwined Luna's axe sword.
The first to strike was Luna. She rapidly closed the distance with Shimat, scattering red sword energy.
However, her sword was not just destructive and aggressive like the Luna of the past. Luna moved lightly like the wind, swinging her axe sword at Shimat.
Despite the grand energy of their swords entangling, small and sharp metallic sounds spread like an ordinary knights' duel.
But with each clash of swords, Luna had to endure the impact of the purple electric energy flowing into her body. Her red sword energy couldn't easily penetrate Shimat.
"I owe a debt to the Blue Wind Emperor and, in some ways, to your brother as well. But I can't let you off."
Swoosh-!
The purple blade grazed Luna's cheek. Luna stepped back to regain her stance, while Shimat did not press her further.
He was confident that Luna would never retreat or flee. This fight would only end with one of them dead.
"Just as I wished. If I was afraid to die fighting you, I wouldn't have come here. So show me everything, as this will be your last fight."
